configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server that appears in the server list

configurationFields.label: Server MOTD
configurationFields.description: The message of the day (MOTD) that is shown to joining players can be configured in cstrike/motd.txt. Plain text or HTML formatting is allowed

configurationFields.label: LAN Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will operate as a LAN server: no heartbeat, no authentication, no non-class C addresses, 9999.0 rate, etc

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to connect to the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: See the Security and Privacy menu for configurable options for the server's RCON

configurationFields.label: Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the map to start the server with. If "Custom" is selected, Custom Initial Map must also be specified

configurationFields.label: Custom Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom map to use for the Initial Map, if "Custom" is selected

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation Cycle
configurationFields.description: Sets the map rotation list

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period between map rotations. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Maximum Map Rounds
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of rounds that can be played on a map. Set to 0 to have the Map Rotation Time Limit apply

configurationFields.label: Server Region
configurationFields.description: Sets the server region shown in the server browser

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Allow Spectators
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be allowed to join the server as spectators

configurationFields.label: Install Metamod
configurationFields.description: Sets whether to install and activate [Metamod-AMX](https://www.amxmodx.org/), [Metamod-P](https://metamod-p.sourceforge.net/) or [Metamod-R](https://metamod-r.org/) when the server is updated. Metamod-R only works with reHLDS

configurationFields.label: Install AMX Mod X Plugin
configurationFields.description: If set, the AMX Mod X plugin and Counter-Strike addon will be installed when the server is updated. Requires Metamod to be installed. Activate the plugin by including it in Load Plugins: win32 addons/amxmodx/dlls/amxmodx_mm.dll | linux addons/amxmodx/dlls/amxmodx_mm_i386.so

configurationFields.label: Load Plugins
configurationFields.description: Sets a list of Metamod plugins to load when the server is started. Requires Metamod to be installed. Format: win32|linux <path to .dll/.so>

configurationFields.label: Enable Cheats
configurationFields.description: If set, cheat convars will be allowed to be used on the server

configurationFields.label: Enable IP Packet Filter
configurationFields.description: If set, enables packet filtering by IP mode. If disabled, everyone will treated as IP-banned, but their IP won't be added to the banlist

configurationFields.label: Allow Download From Server
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to download content from the server (maps, sprays and related)

configurationFields.label: Fast Download URLs
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL(s) for clients to download custom content from, instead of sourcing the content from the server. This allows for faster downloads

configurationFields.label: Allow Upload To Server
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to upload customisation files to the server

configurationFields.label: Minimum Client Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum allowable bandwidth rate a client may have set when connected to the server. 0 = no minimum

configurationFields.label: Maximum Client Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum allowable bandwidth rate a client may have set when connected to the server. 0 = no limit

configurationFields.label: Minimum Server Update Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum number of updates per second of the positions of the server's models (players, guns, etc) that server sends to clients

configurationFields.label: Maximum Server Update Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of updates per second of the positions of the server's models (players, guns, etc) that server sends to clients

configurationFields.label: Tick Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of frames per second (FPS) that the server can calculate

configurationFields.label: Disable Valve Anti-Cheat
configurationFields.description: If set, Valve Anti-Cheat (VAC) will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Ping Boost
configurationFields.description: Selects between optimised network code stack. Setting at 2 usually reduces latency toward 1ms without loss of activity input packets

configurationFields.label: Log Chat Messages
configurationFields.description: If set, logging of chat messages will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Additional Command Line Parameters
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional command line parameters (anything that begins with a -) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Additional Console Variables
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional console variables (anything that begins with a +) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care. Preferably, specify the equivalent under "Additional Server Settings"

configurationFields.label: Additional Server Settings
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional settings to include in "server.cfg" that are not otherwise set by GSCS. One setting per line

configurationFields.label: Map Vote Ratio
configurationFields.description: Sets the ratio of players required to vote on the same map before the server changes to that map. Example: 0.66 = 66%

configurationFields.label: Automatic Team Balancing
configurationFields.description: Sets the automatic team balancing mode. If on, the server will ensure at the relevant time that teams are balanced and that there is no advantaged team

configurationFields.label: Limit Teams
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that one team can have over the other. 0 = team limiting disabled

configurationFields.label: Maximum Player Movement Speed
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum speed that a player can move at when on the ground

configurationFields.label: Enable Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If set, friendly fire will be enabled (teammates can cause damage to other teammates)

configurationFields.label: Enable Flashlight
configurationFields.description: If sets, allows the use of the flashlight by pressing the F button

configurationFields.label: Enable Footsteps
configurationFields.description: If set, footstep sounds will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Auto Aim
configurationFields.description: If set, enables auto aim when a player's crosshair is near an enemy

configurationFields.label: Enable Auto Crosshair
configurationFields.description: If set, the red crosshair will be enabled. Requires Auto Aim to be enabled

configurationFields.label: Allow Players To Pause Server
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be able to pause the server. Not recommended

configurationFields.label: Allow All Talk
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can communicate with all other players, with no team restrictions

configurationFields.label: Spectator Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the spectator mode for dead players

options.1: Spectators can only spectate their own team
options.2: Spectators can't spectate anyone and can only see their dead body

configurationFields.label: Enable Fade To Black
configurationFields.description: If enabled, a player's screen fades to black for the remainder of the round after death (HUD and chat still works). Overrides Spectator Mode

configurationFields.label: Enable Auto Kick
configurationFields.description: If set, automatic team-killer banning and idle client kicking will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Buy Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the designated amount of buy time for each round

configurationFields.label: C4 Timer
configurationFields.description: Sets the time after which the C4 bomb will blow up

configurationFields.label: Freeze Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the length of the freeze period at the beginning of rounds. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Hostage Penalty
configurationFields.description: Sets how many hostages can be killed before a player is kicked from the server. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Serverversion
configurationFields.description: Sets the server branch to install. NOTE: Update the server after switching branches!

configurationFields.label: Install reHLDS
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the [reHLDS engine](https://github.com/dreamstalker/rehlds) will be installed to run the server. Only works with the Steam Legacy server. Note: update the server after changing this setting
